issue.subject: bluestore_fsck_read_bytes_cap=0 makes deep fsck/repair loop forever
issue.description:
|Kind|hang (100% CPU)| |Severity|minor| |Config|@bluestore_fsck_read_bytes_cap=0@ (level advanced, default 64M, runtime, no @min@) with a deep fsck: @ceph-bluestore-tool fsck/repair --deep@, or an OSD with @bluestore_fsck_on_mount=true@ and @bluestore_fsck_on_mount_deep=true@ (both dev, default false)| |Real-world|*Real tool*: @ceph-bluestore-tool fsck --deep@ on an OSD created by @ceph-osd --mkfs@| |Affected|main, since ced308000ae (v14.1.0). Reproduced on origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a| h3. Summary In the deep branch of @_fsck_check_objects()@ (BlueStore.cc:11038-11057): 
uint64_t max_read_block = cct->_conf->bluestore_fsck_read_bytes_cap;
uint64_t offset = 0;
do {
  uint64_t l = std::min(uint64_t(o->onode.size - offset), max_read_block);
  ...
  offset += l;
} while (offset < o->onode.size);
With the cap at 0, @l@ is 0, @offset@ never advances, and the loop never ends for any object with size > 0 (the OSD superblock written by mkfs is enough). Ceph often uses 0 to mean "unlimited", so this value is a plausible thing to set. h3. Reproduction @repro.sh@: mkfs a 4G OSD; run @fsck --deep 1@ with the default cap (control) and with @--bluestore_fsck_read_bytes_cap=0@ under @timeout 120@. h3. Observed (origin/main 8e6a13e7a9a) 
== control: fsck --deep 1 with default cap
fsck success
rc=0
== fsck --deep 1 with bluestore_fsck_read_bytes_cap=0 (timeout 120s)
rc=124 after 120s
A 5 s run at @debug_bluestore=20@ logs 5,267,035 lines of zero-length reads. h3. Suggested fix Add @min: 4_K@ to the option and guard in code as well (@max_read_block = std::max(cap, min_alloc_size)@, or treat 0 as "no cap"), since the yaml @min@ does not protect callers that set the value through the API. h3. Reproducer files * "repro.sh":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/21-fsck-read-bytes-cap-zero-hang/repro.sh * Test patch for all gtests: "bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch":https://github.com/cephtools/tools/tree/main/trackers/bluestore-2026-09/common/patches/bluestore-bughunt-tests.patch
